quirks.name: Beloved lecturer
quirks.line: Students would follow them into a fire. Publishes nothing.

quirks.name: Grant magnet
quirks.line: Writes proposals in their sleep, and occasionally in lectures.

quirks.name: Never on campus Fridays
quirks.line: Or, it is beginning to appear, Thursdays.

quirks.name: Harsh grader
quirks.line: The median is a C, and the median is proud of it.

quirks.name: Came for the view
quirks.line: Will work for the view. Asks very little else.

quirks.name: A name
quirks.line: People have heard of them. The name costs extra.

quirks.name: Office hours that happen
quirks.line: Holds office hours at the posted time, in the posted room. Legendary.

quirks.name: Committee creature
quirks.line: Sits on every committee, chairs three, and calls this service.

quirks.name: Bench hermit
quirks.line: Lives in the lab. Students report a lamp under the door.

quirks.name: Teaches to the back row
quirks.line: Loudly, with props. The props have a budget line.

quirks.name: One book
quirks.line: Twenty years, one book. A terrific book, by every account but the dean's.

quirks.name: The easy A
quirks.line: The course is always full, everyone leaves happy, and nobody knows anything.

quirks.name: Remembers every advisee
quirks.line: Their name, their thesis, and which of the two they should have chosen.

quirks.name: Serial sabbatical
quirks.line: Applied for a sabbatical the week they arrived. Will apply again.

quirks.name: The feud
quirks.line: Has a feud with a rival department that predates the rival department.

quirks.name: Office hours are a myth
quirks.line: The hours are posted every term. The office, on the evidence, is not.

quirks.name: Brings the dog
quirks.line: A spaniel attends every lecture and has the better attendance of the two.

quirks.name: Answers email by post
quirks.line: Replies to every email in full, on paper, three weeks later. Thinks beautifully in the meantime.

quirks.name: Publishes untranslated
quirks.line: Publishes widely in a language the tenure committee does not read, and has declined to help.

quirks.name: Former rock star
quirks.line: Played bass on a record some of the parents own. The lectures start late and sell out.

quirks.name: Grades everyone a B+
quirks.line: Every paper, every year, a B+. Nobody complains, and nobody can say why.

quirks.name: Shy of students
quirks.line: Brilliant on paper, lectures to the far wall. The far wall has learned a great deal.

quirks.name: Writes the textbook
quirks.line: Writes the textbook, assigns the textbook, and revises it every autumn so last year's will not do.

quirks.name: On sabbatical in spirit
quirks.line: Attends every meeting in body and, at every meeting, is visibly somewhere with a beach.

quirks.name: Marks overnight
quirks.line: Essays go in on Monday and come back on Tuesday, annotated in three colours.

quirks.name: The yellowed notes
quirks.line: Teaches from the same notes for thirty years. They remain, annoyingly, correct.

quirks.name: Always being courted
quirks.line: Has an offer from somewhere else every spring, and mentions it to the dean in March.

quirks.name: Undergraduates in the lab
quirks.line: Any undergraduate who asks gets a bench, a project, and their name fourth on a paper.

quirks.name: Ten minutes late
quirks.line: Starts every lecture ten minutes late and finishes it twenty minutes over, on principle.

quirks.name: Conference circuit
quirks.line: Gives the same paper at eleven conferences a year, to warm applause at each.

quirks.name: Knits in meetings
quirks.line: Knits through every faculty meeting, and has produced over a decade a blanket the length of the agenda.

quirks.name: Taught someone famous
quirks.line: Taught somebody famous once, and teaches every class as though it might happen again.

quirks.name: Field season
quirks.line: Gone from May to September to a dig nobody has seen photographs of. Returns with boxes.

quirks.name: Between retirements
quirks.line: Has announced a retirement four times, and is currently between announcements.

quirks.name: The open door
quirks.line: The door is always open, which is also how the department's biscuits keep leaving.

quirks.name: Espresso diplomat
quirks.line: Owns the only working espresso machine in the building, and with it, most of the department's decisions.

quirks.name: Reviewer Two
quirks.line: Is, somewhere, every author's Reviewer Two, and marks undergraduate essays in the same spirit.

quirks.name: Chalk only
quirks.line: Refuses every screen and writes on the blackboard with both hands. Is right to.

quirks.name: Back from industry
quirks.line: Spent ten years in industry and came back with the contacts, the consultancy, and the car.

quirks.name: The evening seminar
quirks.line: Holds seminars at nine at night. The students who come are few, and devoted for life.

readings.headcount: Everyone on the faculty roster, hired or not yet assigned to a program.
readings.payroll: Every hire's salary for a year; it is paid week by week whether they teach or not.
readings.adminShare: Administration's share of all payroll: it only ever creeps up.
readings.teaching: Program quality averaged over the open programs: faculty skill, damped by understaffing, lifted by tier, worn by the hall.
readings.market: Candidates listed this summer; the list closes when the budget is approved.
readings.teachingSkill: How well they teach, 0 to 100, with their quirk counted.
readings.researchSkill: How well they publish, 0 to 100, with their quirk counted.
readings.salary: What they cost a year, on the faculty payroll from the week they are hired.
readings.programQuality: This program's quality: its faculty's teaching, damped by understaffing, lifted by tier, worn by the hall.
readings.staffing: Hires assigned against the hires this tier needs; below the need, quality is damped.

lines.noFaculty: No one is on the faculty yet. The market opens at Budget & Hiring, in the summer.
lines.marketClosed: The market is closed until Budget & Hiring.
lines.marketOpen: The market is open: {count} candidates are listed, and every one of them is very excited about the opportunity.
lines.marketEmpty: Every candidate is hired. The rest of the summer is quiet.
lines.noProgramsForSchool: No open program in {school}; they can be assigned when one opens.
lines.unfoundedField: Their field, {school}, is not founded here.
lines.unassignedNote: {count} on the roster are not teaching anything.
